firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Douglas telling Devon about themself. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
The village debates a tired teacher. The room is cold — Andres, Emma, Maya against. "More mouths, same fire." (19% for.)

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
